name: Scoriaceous-Ossuary

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past towering mountain ranges, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
For traders, exotic matter alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
